speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash; could you please tell me exactly when you first noticed the skin changes and if the baby seems feverish or irritable?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Dermatitis.

The mother's history of untreated gonorrhea raises a high suspicion for vertical transmission. I am requesting a Gram stain and culture of the rash lesions to confirm the presence of Neisseria gonorrhoeae.
REQUEST TEST: Gram_Stain_of_rash_lesions
